name: Capacity Boost xApp
description: Boosts throughput under congestion by scaling bandwidth and transmit power. It selects the highest queue-pressure UE per cell with light SINR bias. It may increase interference and energy usage.

control_parameters.semantic: Increase available PRBs per cell when load is high.
Increase cell transmit power to improve SINR under load.
Prioritize high backlog UEs with light SINR bias.
